titulo: Hold the ladder while they change the bulb
caption:
Hold the ladder while they change the bulb

The bulb is out. One figure climbs the ladder and the other leans on it the whole time, so it doesn't move.

For whoever holds the ladder.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a pink wall. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes leans on the foot of a wooden ladder on the left of it and looks up. A royal blue figure climbs the ladder step by step to a gray bulb near the ceiling. The gray bulb goes away and a yellow one lights up with a glow, and the royal blue figure's eyes close in a smile and it pulses. It climbs back down. The black figure straightens, smiles, and a star appears. The text stays: 1 ladder, held the whole time. The last card: for whoever holds the ladder, Choose friction.
